The depth is **1**.

I did not derive this in full. It matches what I recall of the literature on symbolic powers of cover ideals of cycles, and I checked it only for the smallest case.

- **Dimension bound:** The minimal primes of $J(C_n)^{(t)}$ are the minimal primes of $J(C_n)$, namely $(x_i : i \in C)$ for minimal vertex covers $C$. The smallest vertex cover of $C_n$ has size $\lceil n/2\rceil$, so $\dim S/J(C_n)^{(t)} = n - \lceil n/2\rceil = \lfloor n/2\rfloor$, which is at least 1 for $n \ge 3$.
- **Depth at least 1:** Depth is 0 exactly when the maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ is associated to $J(C_n)^{(t)}$, i.e. some monomial $f \notin J(C_n)^{(t)}$ has $x_i f \in J(C_n)^{(t)}$ for every $i$. For $n=3$, $t=2$, I checked that no such monomial exists among the small candidates I tried, so depth is at least 1 there. I did not check a general proof of this.
- **Depth at most 1:** I recall the result that the depth stabilises at 1 for $t \ge 2$, but I did not verify this from first principles.

ANSWER: 1
